children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) reported FY26 revenue ₹1,91,218.6cr and profit ₹74,671.3cr with NIM 3.34%, cut MCLR rates in Sept, saw courts dismiss AT1 bond suits, and its board sent two MD & CEO candidates to the RBI as Parag Parikh raised stake to 158.729m ADRs.
HDFC Bank FY26 Revenue, Profit Rise
: HDFCBANK FY26: net revenue ₹1,91,218.6 crore (+13.6% YoY); net profit ₹74,671.3 crore (+10.9%); NII ₹1,28,686 crore (+4.9%); NIM 3.34%; deposits ₹31,05,250 crore; advances ₹29,37,166 crore.
HDFC Bank Board Proposes MD & CEO Candidates
: HDFC Bank (HDFCBANK): board submitted two ranked candidates for three-year MD & CEO to Reserve Bank of India, including internal deputy Kaizad M Bharucha, and proposed their pay for RBI approval
HDFCBANK Bahrain Suit Dismissals, Shares Dip
: HDFCBANK faced seven Bahrain investor suits over CS AT1 bonds; courts dismissed all for lack of evidence, finding no gross negligence. Shares fell about 1.3% intraday after two rejections.
: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund boosted HDFCBANK stake in August 2026 by 9.002 million ADRs to about 158.729 million, making it the fund’s largest holding at 7.63% of AUM.
: HDFCBANK cut MCLR rates effective Sept 7, 2026: overnight/1‑month 7.90%, 3‑month 8.05%, 6‑month 8.25%, 1‑yr 8.35%, 2‑yr 8.45%, 3‑yr 8.60% (down 5–10bps). Applies to MCLR‑linked loans.
